jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to own and evolve the data foundation behind People Analytics. You will turn complex People data into clean, trusted and well-modeled data products used across People, Finance and Management. Sitting at the intersection of data engineering and analytics, you will own the transformation layer from raw data to reliable models, metrics and insights. You will work hands-on with SQL, dbt, Snowflake and Python, while using AI to accelerate how we build, analyze and work with data. This is a role with significant ownership: you will shape how People data is modeled, tested and made accessible across the organization What you'll do Build and own scalable, tested data models and transformations using dbt and SQL, with Snowflake as our data platform. Design the data models and architecture behind our People Analytics products, creating a trusted foundation for reporting and decision-making. Build analytics products and dashboards directly in Snowflake, making reliable People data accessible across the organization. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: TL;DR Join GlassDollar and help build the system some of Europe's largest companies use to find, test, and adopt startup technology. We're looking for an engineer who wants considerably more responsibility than "implement what's in the ticket". You'll take an ambiguous problem, shape it together with product, make the important technical decisions, ship it, and stay close enough to see whether it worked. We expect you to have opinions. We also expect you to be good enough to change them. The problem we're solving Large organisations are remarkably good at accumulating problems. A company with 100,000 employees can have thousands of operational challenges across its business units. Somewhere outside that organisation, a startup has probably already built part of the solution. Getting those two things to meet still happens through spreadsheets, long email threads, and meetings whose primary output is another meeting. GlassDollar OS is the operating system for venture clienting: problem → startup discovery → evaluation → PoC → adoption, in one repeatable workflow. Our customers are some of Europe's largest organisations, so the software has to move quickly and behave like something an enterprise can depend on. That tension creates the interesting engineering problems. What we're looking for You can take a problem further than the ticket. Work often starts with something incomplete, like "customers need a better way to manage X". You'll shape the problem with product, challenge assumptions, and decide what belongs in this iteration. Strong opinions about what we build, not only how, are expected here. You care about product. You want to know who you're building for, why the problem matters, and what success looks like. That context should shape your technical decisions. You have technical judgement. There is rarely one correct architecture. You know when the boring solution beats the ambitious one, when an abstraction helps and when it hides the problem, and when a small feature is about to create six months of technical debt. We expect you to reason about API boundaries, data models, permissions, performance, failure modes, testing, observability, and rollout, and to raise concerns with a clear argument attached. You make the system better, not just the feature. You fix the spreading pattern rather than the single instance, make an API easier for the next person, and improve tests because the current setup makes everyone afraid to deploy. Your impact should show beyond the pull requests with your name on them. You can work across the stack. A feature might run from a React interaction through GraphQL into a Node service, a schema redesign, a permissions update, and a safe migration for existing customers. Curiosity to follow the problem matters more than equal depth everywhere. You own quality. We have QA. That's not where quality begins. What breaks if this request happens twice? What happens with old data, or when the API fails halfway through? We use Playwright and Jest alongside reviews and monitoring. The goal isn't coverage, it's confidence. You communicate like your decisions will matter later. Six months from now, somebody should understand an important decision without digging through seventeen Slack messages and a deleted Notion comment. That means writing things down when they matter, explaining trade-offs clearly, giving useful code reviews, and surfacing risks before they become incidents. You raise the engineering bar around you. You do not need a management title to have influence. Find the hole in an architecture, unblock someone without taking the keyboard away, disagree without turning every decision into a referendum. As you earn trust, you’ll naturally become the person people bring harder problems to. What you'll do Over your first year: Enterprise integrations: into our customers' systems, data, identity providers, and workflows. Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature. Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself. The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder. GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter. What we're looking for You have personally written the tickets. 3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off. You are technical enough to argue with engineers. AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better. You can write. A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second. You write specs worth acting on. The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter. You know what looks good. You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually. You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec. You want to be coached hard. Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast. You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. We want to see the workflow, not hear it described. You want the scope to grow. The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available. What you'll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. jobs.title: Senior Conversion Design Analyst (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Your mission We're looking for a Senior Conversion Design Analyst who decides with evidence. You will frame real user problems based on qualitative and quantitative data, design a part of our product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and analyze the results yourself. You will sit inside the product delivery team that focuses on user growth, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it. And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards. English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read. Concretely, you will: Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them. Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle Run the experiment, and read it honestly. Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and saying what you would do differently. Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody. Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less. Your profile You practice product design and analytics. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa. You have technical know-how and experience in setting up and evaluating experiments in an A/B testing tool, constructing the needed dashboards for the problem space you are working on and use our design system tooling. With sufficient data literacy, you get your own numbers through SQL query. You work with raw data to dig up insights and spot opportunities, without waiting for someone else to pull it for you. You have run experiments end to end: set up the hypothesis, decide on the right metrics to track, design the test variants, analyze the results, decide on how to continue. You have statistical literacy. You don’t need to be able to run R, but you understand what Bayesian vs. frequentist is about and why you do a power analysis before launching an experiment. You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about. You are fluent with AI tools. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd. Excellent English skills for working in our international team. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Introduction At a glance Location & work model : Berlin, hybrid Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester ( KubeVirt ), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must Why this role is special Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. Your first 90 days You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. jobs.title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Aufgaben Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus! Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps. Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic -basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter. Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich. Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents – zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures. Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign . Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment -Prozesse mit. Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen. Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: PHP und Laravel Statamic PostgreSQL Livewire HTML, CSS und JavaScript RESTful APIs Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment -Prozessen Large Language Models und Coding Agents Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt. Qualifikation Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich in Laravel , Statamic , PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und Coding Agents sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen. Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern, Deployment und grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten. Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen. Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten. Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen

jobs.title: Senior Odoo Engineer ERP & E-Commerce (all genders)
jobs.description: Introduction Do you want to do more than just maintain an ERP system—do you want to help shape its future? As a Senior Odoo Engineer for ERP & E-Commerce (all genders), you’ll take responsibility for our Odoo platform—the system that powers sales, order processing, logistics, and accounting. You’ll further develop our in-house modules, continue the migration to the Odoo standard, integrate new countries, standardize payment processes, and build our new online store—ensuring it’s fully upgradeable, with streamlined workflows and genuine creative freedom. Your mission The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. In doing so, you’ll rely on an upgrade-friendly architecture based on inheritance rather than modifications to the Odoo core Another key focus of your work will be migrating existing processes to the Odoo standard and integrating new countries—including localization, accounting, and country-specific requirements You’ll ensure seamless and efficient payment processes by integrating PSP connections, SEPA direct debit, and PSD2/SCA, and by managing the interfaces with adjacent systems Together with the relevant stakeholders, you’ll implement our new, mobile-friendly website and online store based on Odoo E-Commerce You ensure code quality and testability, document architecture and design decisions, and provide technical guidance to development partners Your profile You have several years of experience in Odoo development with Python and have implemented your own modules from requirements through to go-live You have worked with Odoo Enterprise in production environments—including Odoo.sh—for several years and are proficient with Git in professional development and deployment processes For you, Odoo is not just a configuration tool: ORM, inheritance, Views, and QWeb, access rights, and cron jobs are all part of your skill set—ideally complemented by Odoo E-Commerce You confidently analyze existing software, refactor it strategically, and further develop it with a focus on quality, maintainability, and stability Experience with Odoo upgrades, data migrations, multi-company setups, or integrating payment service providers is a definite plus You work in a structured and independent manner, document clearly, and communicate on an equal footing in German and English Why us? Modern Office: Look forward to an ergonomic workspace in Munich with a height-adjustable desk, plenty of greenery from plants, an open atmosphere, and short decision-making paths. Attractive Benefits: Monthly deposits to your EmployeeCARD, subsidies for cell phone and internet service, bike leasing, car subscription, retirement savings, and more . jobs.title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
jobs.description: What we do At Briink , we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials. Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide. We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good. Application requirement: Intro video As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering: Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. Track record of delivering measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications. jobs.title: Electric Propulsion Engineer
jobs.description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Role Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. As Electric Propulsion Engineer, you own the design of that thruster: you calculate it, design it, build it, test it in our own vacuum facilities and feed what you learn straight into the next iteration. You own the testing of your own designs, and your results decide what flies. Responsibilities Design Own the design of our RF gridded ion thruster and its performance calculations, from concept to flight configuration. Iterate rapidly to support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries. Work with mechanical, electrical and control engineers on each new iteration of the ion propulsion system. Build and test Design and build the test rigs and equipment for propulsion testing. Assemble and operate test hardware, electronics and vacuum facilities. Run electric propulsion tests on your own designs and analyse the results. Plan and run the test campaigns for your own designs. Verify Turn test results into design changes, then re-test. Document every test configuration and result so it gives traceable evidence for system verification and qualification. Requirements Essential Strong knowledge of RF gridded ion thrusters, including RF plasma generation, ion optics and neutralisation. Hands-on electric propulsion testing, ideally with RF generators, high-voltage power supplies and thrust balances. Experience with vacuum systems (pumps, gauges, valves), power supplies, fluid management (high-pressure gas tanks, mass flow controllers) and data acquisition. Solid grounding in plasma physics, modelling, diagnostics and ionisation processes. Willingness to design, build and test your own hardware, and to work extended hours on-site. Nice to have Experience taking a thruster from design through qualification to flight hardware. Scripting for data analysis and test automation (Python or MATLAB). Experience running thrusters on more than one propellant, such as xenon, krypton or air. We are recruiting across propulsion design and test. Apply to whichever role fits you best - strong candidates may be considered for either. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the Team Our global Legal team has built a strong reputation within the company for our highly collaborative and supportive approach to counseling, always with a bias for action. We are a diverse group of lawyers and legal professionals with a shared passion for providing creative, best-in-class service to our business partners. The Competition & Litigation team advises DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo on antitrust, competition, and litigation matters across every market we operate in. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you'll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ or Brussels office for a minimum of 3 days a week.  You're excited about this opportunity because you will… Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk. Advise on the competition and antitrust dimensions of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and commercial partnerships, partnering closely with Corporate Development and our sales teams. Manage antitrust and competition regulatory investigations and inquiries globally. Help build out DoorDash's international competition compliance program, partnering with the Director, Competition & Litigation on training, policies, and processes across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. Support competition-related litigation matters as needed, including document collection and review, witness preparation, and responses to third-party subpoenas. Partner with policy and government relations teams to track legal and regulatory developments that could affect the business. We're excited about you because… You are a qualified solicitor in England & Wales (or bring similar qualifications in another European jurisdiction) with significant experience providing strategic legal advice to international businesses. You have 7+ years of experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department, with a strong grounding in antitrust/competition law as a generalist — spanning M&A counseling, litigation, and regulatory/government investigations. You have experience advising on competition issues in mergers, acquisitions, and strategic investments, including regulatory filings and clearance strategy. You have experience handling antitrust/competition regulatory inquiries or investigations, ideally including direct engagement with regulators such as the European Commission, UK CMA, DOJ, FTC, or other competition authorities. You're comfortable operating as a generalist across a broad portfolio — you don't need deep pre-existing expertise in every sub-area, but you can quickly get up to speed and give practical, business-minded advice. You're an excellent product counselor: able to translate complex antitrust concepts into clear, fast, actionable guidance for product and business teams. You're comfortable working across multiple jurisdictions and legal systems, and can navigate the added complexity of advising across three global brands (DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo). You have strong organizational skills and can juggle multiple concurrent workstreams

jobs.title: Stateful Services Engineer
jobs.description: Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI and human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly. As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Stateful Services Engineer to help build and operate the infrastructure foundation behind the platform. This is a unique opportunity to work on an infrastructure environment combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads , while helping us build the reliability and operational maturity required to support 3x growth . You will report to the newly forming Stateful Services Lead and work closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure teams to improve the reliability, scalability and evolution of our stateful systems. Your mission Your goal is to build, operate and improve Diabolocom’s stateful services , with a strong focus on databases and data stores. You will help ensure that our databases and stateful systems remain highly available, reliable and performant, while evolving our infrastructure so that maintenance, upgrades and scaling can be performed safely and with minimal to no downtime. Working closely with the Stateful Services Lead, you will take ownership of specific technical projects and contribute to the evolution of our stateful infrastructure. You will: Operate and maintain our stateful services , including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ and Kafka/Redpanda. Contribute to the design, evolution and scaling of our database infrastructure, with 50+ PostgreSQL clusters and increasingly complex data workloads. Work on projects aimed at making database maintenance, upgrades and migrations safer and less disruptive to our services. Improve high availability, replication, failover, backup/restore and disaster recovery across our stateful systems. Contribute to rebuilding our PostgreSQL clusters to support automatic failover between data centers and reduce the impact of maintenance operations. Help improving our queueing infrastructure, including projects such as quorum-based RabbitMQ . Help building and maintaining stable Redis infrastructure and improve the reliability of our stateful services. Investigate and solve complex performance, scalability and reliability issues across databases and distributed systems. Work closely with development teams to understand their needs, support their use of databases and help them build reliable solutions. Collaborate with SRE, networking and infrastructure teams to ensure that our stateful services operate reliably within our broader infrastructure. Contribute to monitoring, automation and operational practices that make our infrastructure easier and safer to operate. Participate in our on-call and incident management rotation , helping diagnose and resolve production issues when needed. Stay hands-on and close to the technology: you will be expected to understand how our systems work, how they fail and how to improve them. Who we are looking for We’re looking for a technically strong and hands-on Stateful Services Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and taking ownership of production systems where reliability really matters. You have experience operating databases or stateful services in production and understand that running these systems is about much more than simply maintaining them. You know how to troubleshoot them, how they behave under load, how they fail, and how to make them more reliable as they scale. You’ll work on specific technical projects defined with the Stateful Services Lead, while having the autonomy to investigate problems, propose solutions and contribute to technical decisions. We care more about your technical depth, curiosity and ability to take ownership than the exact number of years of experience you have. Must Have Strong hands-on experience as a DBA, Database Enginee

jobs.title: Account Executive Manager | SMB | French Market (Paris)

Recruter, onboarder et faire monter en compétence les AE, avec un plan de ramp-up et des jalons clairs. Gérer la performance : attentes claires, rituels hebdomadaires (WBR), diagnostic des causes (compétence, motivation, territoire, message) et action rapide en cas de sous-performance. Collaborer avec le Marketing (campagnes, contenus, événements), les Partenariats (canaux locaux, KOLs) et le Produit (remontée des insights terrain). Garantir la discipline process et outils : CRM irréprochable, séquences rigoureuses, reporting fiable. Les faits avant les impressions. Profil recherché Expérience confirmée en management commercial outbound SMB dans le SaaS B2B, avec une équipe d'AE full-cycle atteignant régulièrement ses objectifs. Français natif, anglais courant (clientèle francophone, équipes internes internationales). Intérêt pour le droit : une expérience dans le secteur juridique ou des services professionnels est un plus, mais pas indispensable. Joivy est bien plus qu’une plateforme immobilière : c’est le premier écosystème résidentiel d’Europe conçu pour accompagner chaque étape de la vie. Du coliving au design soigné aux escapades en location de vacances, en passant par le logement étudiant ou des espaces de coworking inspirants, nous créons des lieux où l’on se sent immédiatement chez soi. Un écosystème innovant pour tous les besoins Joivy est l’alliance stratégique de pionniers tels que DoveVivo, Altido, Chez-Nestor et Open . Ensemble, nous redéfinissons les codes du marché : Pour nos résidents : Une offre flexible (colocations, studios, villas) pour des séjours de toutes durées, portée par une expérience numérique fluide. Pour nos partenaires : Un accompagnement premium pour les propriétaires et investisseurs, de la gestion d'actifs à la transformation immobilière grâce à l'intelligence artificielle et des outils d'analyse de pointe. L’aventure Joivy en quelques chiffres clés : Une expertise unique : 450 talents passionnés de plus de 30 nationalités (moyenne d’âge de 32 ans). Une présence XXL : 50 destinations à travers 7 pays (Italie, Espagne, France, Portugal, UK, Luxembourg et Bulgarie). Une force de frappe globale : Près de 2 000 propriétaires accompagnés et plus de 150 000 utilisateurs conquis. Missions Gestion opérationnelle & chantiers : qualifier les interventions, commander les prestations, contacter les artisans et planifier leurs passages (création de bons de travail et organisation du tableau de bord). Suivi & qualité : suivre le traitement des interventions, contrôler la qualité des prestations (artisans, ménage, états des lieux) et formaliser les retours d'expérience. Logistique & stocks : gérer l'organisation des clés via Keynest et assurer le suivi des stocks sur nos différents sites (Barbusse, Louis, Chaligny, Douai). Support & urgences : traiter les tickets techniques dans Zendesk, gérer les urgences opérationnelles avec les prestataires externes et sourcer de nouveaux partenaires. Administration & finance : assurer le suivi de la facturation liée aux opérations. Ton profil Tu fais preuve d'une excellente organisation, d'un esprit méthodologique et d'une grande rigueur pour mener à bien le suivi des interventions. Tu te montres autonome, réactif(-ve) et capable de garder ton sang-froid face aux imprévus et au stress du terrain. Tu es parfaitement à l'aise avec les outils informatiques, la suite Microsoft et le traitement de données ou de reporting. Tu possèdes un très bon relationnel pour échanger efficacement avec nos prestataires et artisans partenaires. Tu maîtrises le français à l'écrit comme à l'oral (l'anglais est un atout). Pour que ton expérience chez Joivy France soit aussi enrichissante que stimulante, nous mettons tout en œuvre pour t'offrir un cadre de travail privilégié : Un stage rémunéré qui reconnaît ton engagement et ta contribution réelle à nos succès. Intègre une communauté unie, motivée et collaborative, où l'entraide est le moteur de chaque défi relevé. Entre nos afterworks mémorables, nos compétitions de tir au Nerf légendaires et nos petits-déjeuners conviviaux chaque mardi, la cohésion est notre priorité. Profite de 2 jours de télétravail par semaine (au bout de trois mois d’ancienneté) pour concilier au mieux tes missions et ta vie personnelle. Des tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 9 €/jour (via carte Edenred), et la prise en charge à 50% de ton abonnement de transport. L'accès exclusif aux dad jokes incontournables de notre collègue Loeiz, garanties 100% authentiques pour illuminer tes journées. jobs.description: Vous souhaitez intervenir sur un projet technologique concret, au croisement du logiciel, de l'IoT, de la data et de l'intelligence artificielle ? Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Logiciel Full Stack & IoT pour participer au développement et à l'évolution d'une plateforme permettant de collecter, traiter, superviser et exploiter les données issues d'équipements connectés . With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team. We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build. This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional. What You Will Do Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers. Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder. Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up. Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling. Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made. Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked. jobs.title: Network Developer
jobs.description: Senior Network Developer About Share Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months. Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served. The Role Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices. You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team. What you'll do Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time. Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist. Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable. Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change. Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop. Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system. Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off. Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you. Our Ideal Candidate 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP. Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit. Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense. Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you. You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe. You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed. AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't. You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network. A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders. Nice to have Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale. Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them

jobs.title: Network Operation Engineer
jobs.description: Network Operations Engineer 1. About the role Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it. For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar. We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling. The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes. You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it. 2. What you'll do Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing. Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with. Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. jobs.description: Your creative field At GPORTAL , our vision is to build individual and easy-to-use online gaming experiences for the world. Driven by our “from gamer for gamer” passion, we've grown into one of the leading game server providers - offering more than just servers, unlike other hosting companies. For over 20 years, we've been bringing virtual worlds into people's homes with just a few clicks. Our mission: enabling experts and beginners alike to play their favourite games together with their friends. From Palworld and Enshrouded to Minecraft and Battlefield, we offer around 100 multiplayer games across every genre. GPORTAL is looking for a Director Marketing who is ready to take the wheel of our entire marketing department, performance marketing, social media, partner management, community management, and graphic design. Reporting directly to our CEO, you will be part of the core management team from day one, with the kind of ownership over people and KPIs you will not find in every gaming company. In your first six months, the priority is simple: keep the team running strong while you get a real feel for GPORTAL's business, our vision, and where we are headed. You will take full budget responsibility, from managing current spend and staying on top of marketing invoices to building the annual forecast. You will also size up the market to derive strategic conclusions on where we push next. From there, you settle in as a driving force in our management team and sharpen how the marketing department works so it is well set up for the future. That includes working hand in hand with our tech teams on product-related topics such as checkout flows or game updates and launches. You also take full responsibility for onboarding, managing, and offboarding our external agencies and freelancers. On top of that, you build real connections with the marketing team over at Contabo Group to create synergies wherever possible. Just as important: brand visibility and closeness to the community. Alongside that, you own our marketing campaigns with partner studios and the big moments like Black Friday. Last but not least, you advise our CEO directly on D2C pricing based on comprehensive market assessments, both the operative calls today and the strategic thinking further out. Longer term, you push the KPIs that matter and build retention measures that keep players around. You also shape a team structure that can scale with us. That also means preparing and presenting marketing reporting and KPIs at Group and shareholder level. And you run and assess customer surveys, turning what you learn into decisions we actually act on. Gaming is a volatile business, and the classic playbook does not always deliver a straight line to growth. We are all pulling for the same outcome for the wider group, which sometimes means short-term compromises we make together. Und Dich hier wiedererkennst Laufendes Studium, mindestens im 3. jobs.description: Introduction Führe als Customer Success Manager (w/m/d) bei omnora unsere Kunden zu nachhaltigem Erfolg beim Thema Wissenstransfer. Erfolg siehst du vor allem anhand zweier Kriterien: Durch die wertvolle Nutzung unserer Plattform und durch die Umsatzsteigerungen, die sich durch den Mehrwert für unsere Kunden ergeben. Bei omnora setzen wir auf High-Touch Customer-Success, sodass du mit deinen Kunden im engen Austausch bist. Einerseits berätst du mit kreativen Lösungen bei der Implementierung und Nutzung der Plattform. Andererseits erkennst du Kundenbedarfe und unterstützt unsere Ansprechpartner beim Vertriebsprozess, um das Thema Wissenstransfer im Unternehmen voranzutreiben. About The Role And Potential Progression In deiner Rolle als Customer Success Manager bei omnora bieten sich dir klar definierte Entwicklungspfade, die sowohl auf die kurzfristige Spezialisierung als auch auf langfristige Karriereziele ausgerichtet sind. Beginne deine Karriere mit einer tiefgehenden Spezialisierung in Schlüsselbereichen, die für einen Key Account Manager unerlässlich sind, und steuere dann auf eine Rolle mit übergreifender Umsatzverantwortung zu. Einblicke in die kurzfristige Spezialisierung: Vertriebskompetenzen: Vertiefe deine Fähigkeiten im Vertrieb, indem du effektive Verkaufsstrategien und -taktiken erlernst, die auf die Bedürfnisse großer Accounts zugeschnitten sind. Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Entwickle deine kommunikativen Fähigkeiten weiter, um effektiv mit Kunden zu verhandeln, ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und überzeugende Präsentationen zu halten. Beratungskompetenz: Erweitere deine Beratungsfähigkeiten, um Kundenbedürfnisse zu analysieren und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zu entwickeln, die den Mehrwert und den Umsatz steigern. Business Case Entwicklung: Lerne, überzeugende Business Cases zu erstellen, die die Vorteile deiner Lösungen klar kommunizieren und intern wie extern verteidigt werden können. Accountanalyse: Vertiefe dein Verständnis für die Analyse von Kundenaccounts, um Potenziale für Upselling und Cross-Selling zu erkennen und zu nutzen. Mittelfristige Entwicklung: Key Account Management: Nachdem du Erfahrung in den oben genannten Bereichen gesammelt hast, steigst du in das Key Account Management auf, wo du strategische Verantwortung für die Betreuung und Entwicklung unserer größten und umsatzstärksten Kunden übernimmst. Deine Aufgabe wird es sein, langfristige Beziehungen zu pflegen und die Umsatzverantwortung für diese wichtigen Accounts zu tragen. Langfristige Karriereperspektiven: Führungspositionen: Langfristig bietet sich die Möglichkeit, in Führungspositionen innerhalb des Vertriebs, des Customer Success oder des Business Development aufzusteigen. In diesen Rollen übernimmst du die Leitung von Teams oder Abteilungen, entwickelst strategische Initiativen zur Geschäftsentwicklung und treibst das Unternehmenswachstum voran. What's in it for you Leistungsorientierte Boni: Erhalte quartalsweise ausgeschüttete Boni bei Erreichung deiner Ziele, um deinen Erfolg direkt zu belohnen. Verwirklichung statt politische Entscheidungen: Entfalte dein Potenzial in einer Unternehmenskultur, die Eigenverantwortung schätzt und datengetriebene Entscheidungen fördert. Dynamisches Lernen: Entwickle dich stetig weiter mit Zugang zu Büchern, Coachings und LinkedIn Learning – alles ohne Angst vor Fehlern. Ausgezeichnete Arbeitsumgebung: Als mehrfach ausgezeichnetes Top-Unternehmen bieten wir ein Umfeld, das berufliches Wachstum unterstützt und Wertschätzung garantiert. Flexibilität und Chancengleichheit: Nutze flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit der Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice. Bei uns zählt dein Beitrag, unabhängig von deiner Position. Hundefreundliches Büro: Bringe deinen Hund mit – bei uns sind alle Familienmitglieder willkommen. Gemeinsame Feiern: Erlebe, wie wir Erfolge bei Teamevents, von Sommerfesten bis Weinwanderungen, gemeinsam feiern. Aufgaben Als Werkstudent:in im digitalen Produktmanagement arbeitest du an den verschiedenen digitalen Produkten und Zukunftsthemen der Pflegehelden. Dazu gehören unser eigenentwickeltes CRM, der Heldenplaner, sowie unsere App und das Support-Ticketsystem. Außerdem beschäftigen wir uns intensiv damit, wie wir bestehende Prozesse mithilfe von KI vereinfachen und verbessern können. Der Heldenplaner bildet den gesamten Vermittlungsprozess ab und wird täglich von unseren Franchise-Partner:innen, Vermittlungsagenturen und Mitarbeitenden genutzt. Du unterstützt die Head of Product und das Entwicklungsteam über den gesamten Produktprozess hinweg, von der ersten Idee und der Analyse bestehender Abläufe bis zum erfolgreichen Einsatz neuer Funktionen. Was dich bei uns konkret erwartet: Du testest neue Funktionen im Heldenplaner und in der App, dokumentierst die Ergebnisse und unterstützt bei der fachlichen Abnahme. Du bearbeitest Supportanfragen aus unserem Ticketsystem, klärst Anliegen mit unseren Nutzer:innen und erkennst wiederkehrende Fragen / Probleme. Daraus leitest du Verbesserungen für unsere Produkte und Prozesse ab. Du formulierst verständliche Entwicklungstickets, ergänzt Akzeptanzkriterien und klärst offene fachliche Fragen. Du unterstützt bei Recherchen, Konzepten und einfachen Prototypen. Dabei erprobst du unter anderem, wie wir Prozesse mithilfe von KI effizienter gestalten können. Du unterstützt uns dabei, Produkt-, Nutzungs- und Prozessdaten aufzubereiten und auszuwerten. Dabei wirkst du an Dashboards und Analysen in Power BI mit und hilfst uns, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse für unsere Produkte abzuleiten. Du begleitest Rollouts und erstellst verständliche Anleitungen, Release-Informationen und Schulungsunterlagen. Du übernimmst schrittweise eigene Themen und hältst Vereinbarungen sowie offene Aufgaben zuverlässig nach. Deine Aufgaben sind bewusst vielseitig. Durch Datenanalyse, Qualitätssicherung und den direkten Austausch mit unseren Nutzer:innen lernst du unsere Produkte kennen. Gleichzeitig erhältst du Einblicke in verschiedene Bereiche moderner Produktarbeit und kannst diese aktiv mitgestalten. Qualifikation Du bist an einer Hochschule oder Universität eingeschrieben, beispielsweise in Medienmanagement, (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, BWL oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Du interessierst dich dafür, wie digitale Produkte entstehen und wie aus einem echten Nutzer:innenproblem eine gute Lösung wird. Du hast Interesse an Datenanalyse und bringst Erfahrungen mit Excel mit. Kenntnisse in Power BI sind ein Plus. Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte strukturiert erfassen und verständlich formulieren und arbeitest sorgfältig. Du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder nächste Schritt vorgegeben wird. Du arbeitest gern mit unterschiedlichen Menschen zusammen, darunter Entwickler:innen und unsere Franchise-Partner:innen. Du bist neugierig, stellst den Status quo konstruktiv infrage und möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen. Erste Erfahrungen mit Tools wie Miro oder Figma sowie im Produkt- oder Projektmanagement, User Research, Datenanalyse oder Softwareentwicklung sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wichtiger sind uns deine Lernbereitschaft, dein strukturiertes Denken und deine Zuverlässigkeit. Benefits Eine sinnstiftende Aufgabe: Unsere digitalen Produkte unterstützen Menschen dabei, möglichst lange in ihrem eigenen Zuhause leben zu können. Ein kleines, motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Kontakt zur Head of Product. Ein vielseitiger Einblick in Produktstrategie, Discovery, Softwareentwicklung, Testing, Rollout und Produktbetrieb. Schrittweise wachsende Verantwortung für eigene Themen. Raum

jobs.title: Pflichtpraktikum Sustainability Account Management (all genders)
jobs.description: JOIN US Bei Code Gaia zu arbeiten bedeutet, dass du an etwas sehr Wichtigem arbeitest: Der Transformation zu einer nachhaltigen Wirtschaft. Stattdessen wollen wir kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen ermutigen, gemeinsam gegen den Klimawandel und soziale Ungerechtigkeit vorzugehen. Als Internal Accountant bist du das Rückgrat unserer täglichen Finanzprozesse: Du verantwortest die laufende Buchhaltung, sorgst für saubere und pünktliche Zahlungsläufe und bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere externe Steuerberatung. Experience with BESS, power electronics, industrial electrical equipment, automation, or comparable complex technical products. Practical experience interpreting technical standards and translating them into engineering requirements. Good understanding of electrical safety, EMC, system safety, testing, and technical product documentation. Understanding of cybersecurity and compliance requirements for connected industrial products. Experience working with external test laboratories and certification bodies. Ability to understand system architectures, electrical schematics, specifications, software interfaces, and test reports. Strong technical communication skills and a structured, independent working style. Fluent English. Location: You’ll be based at our office in Cologne (Belgisches Viertel) and should be on site at least twice a week. Experience: You have 5–8 years of experience in strategy & operations and feel confident in your role. Languages are no problem: You speak German and English fluently. Your connection to football: You're genuinely interested in amateur football and have a feel for what moves this community. Start-up spirit: You prefer to play an active part in shaping things rather than just going through the motions – even if that sometimes means tackling things without a ready-made roadmap. What you'll do - your playing field This is how you move our mission forward every day. You own selected strategic and operational projects end-to-end. You take projects from the initial idea and concept through planning and execution to measurable results. You build and continuously improve our core company processes. You create clear structures and scalable ways of working that help the organization operate more effectively as we grow. You work closely with Nik on cross-functional strategic projects and priorities. You bring different teams and perspectives together, create clarity on what matters most, and make sure important initiatives move forward. In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also: Supporting process optimization in other operational areas as needed Preparing decision-making materials and analyses for the founder team What you bring to the team We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points. Process & Structure: You think in processes and structures, quickly bring clarity to complex or ambiguous situations, and know how to turn them into pragmatic ways of working. Project Ownership: You have experience independently driving projects from idea to execution in a fast-growing environment and are comfortable taking responsibility for both strategy and implementation. Tools: You are confident working with Notion, project management tools, Google Workspace, and Slack and use them effectively to create transparency, structure, and efficient collaboration Good to know We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one. This role is significantly more hands-on than the title might suggest: you don't just plan, you execute, and take ownership across shifting topic areas. The exact focus will be sharpened further together with the team. If you're looking for pure strategy work without hands-on execution, this role isn't for you. Bonus Not a must – but this'll definitely earn you extra points. jobs.description: Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO We are looking for a Senior Product Manager ( ISR ) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship. LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests. Tech stack & tools: Linear (backlog, sprints) Confluence Google Workspace LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications Figma QGIS and comparable viewers STAC -based imagery catalogs Data: very high resolution optical imagery synthetic aperture radar 3D surface models cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments agentic tools for a variety of work. Your challenge As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them. Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user. Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters. Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts. Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards. Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim. Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance. You'll take ownership of significant parts of the SurfaceScout application, from the user-facing experience to the services and data flows behind it, and help evolve it into an even more scalable and reliable product. This is a high-ownership role on an established, fast-growing product: part hands-on engineering, part systems design, part technical leadership within the squad. You'll work across the full product lifecycle, from shaping and building new features, to strengthening the architecture and engineering practices that support long-term growth, using a modern TypeScript and Python stack. Your challenge As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the SurfaceScout squad, you'll take ownership of significant parts of a live, growing product, turning ideas into reliable production systems and strengthening the architecture that supports long-term growth. Core responsibilities include: Design and build features end to end (TypeScript & Python), translating product requirements into reliable, well-tested systems that ship to customers. Define and implement integrations with LiveEO's platform and data services, ensuring clean interfaces, reliable data flows, and extensibility for future development. Collaborate across teams to reuse and adapt shared components, aligning on architecture, APIs, and engineering standards across products. Own key architectural decisions (service boundaries, data models, deployment patterns), balancing speed of delivery with long-term maintainability and reliability. Iterate quickly on feedback from product, customers, and stakeholders, evolving features into robust, production-grade solutions. Raise the bar for the squad: mentor teammates, review code, and help shape technical direction as a senior voice on the team. Champion engineering best practices (code quality, documentation, testing, observability), keeping the codebase healthy as the product scales. Contribute across the stack, from backend services and APIs to frontend interfaces, delivering a cohesive and usable end-to-end experience. Your profile Strong engineering fundamentals in TypeScript and Python, with a focus on writing clean, maintainable, and well-structured code. Experience designing and implementing integrations between systems (APIs, data pipelines, third-party services). Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and deploying and operating scalable services. Solid understanding of software architecture and system design, with the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs. Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional environments and aligning with multiple stakeholders. Experience mentoring engineers or setting technical direction within a team. Your Benefits The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe. We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold. Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest. A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons. jobs.title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
jobs.description: Your mission At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments. This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that. The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup. The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation. You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements. This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved. What you will work on Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA - and NGC -based workloads Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC , secrets management, SSO , and tenant boundaries Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows Your profile We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
